Description:

A qualified OOW 3000GT is required for a temporary relief position onboard a 55m+ motor yacht in New Zealand. The contract runs from 17 December 2026 to 12 January 2027, with a salary of €6,000/month (pro rata). The vessel will be in the shipyard during this period, so previous yard experience and a flexible attitude are beneficial. Candidates must hold a valid OOW 3000GT CoC and be available for the full contract duration.

Location: Southampton
Description:

A Tug Master position is available for a permanent, time-for-time contract with a 1 week on / 1 week off rotation. The role requires a Master <500GT CoC or higher, valid ENG1 and STCW certificates, and experience in harbour or terminal towage with ASD and/or Voith propulsion.
